title: When the Roll Is Called Up Yonder

sections.name: Verse 1
lines: [G]When the trumpet of the Lord shall sound, and [C]time shall be no [G]more,
[G]And the morning breaks, eternal, [A7]bright and [D]fair;
When the [G]saved of earth shall gather over [C]on the other [G]shore,
[G]And the roll is called up [D7]yonder, I'll be [G]there.
When the roll is called up yonder,
When the [D7]roll is called up yonder,
When the [G]roll is called up [C]yonder,
When the [G]roll is called up [D7]yonder, I'll be [G]there.

sections.name: Refrain
lines: [G]When the [C]roll is [G]called up yonder,
[G]When the [A7]roll is [D]called up yonder,
[G]When the [C]roll is [G]called up yonder,
[G]When the roll [D7]is called up [G]yonder, I'll be there.

sections.name: Verse 2
lines: [G]On that [C]bright and [G]cloudless morning,
[G]when the [A7]dead in [D]Christ shall rise,
[G]And the [C]glory of [G]His resurection share;
[G]When His [D7]chosen ones [G]shall gather
to their home beyond the skies,
[D7]And the roll is called up yonder, I'll be there.

sections.name: Verse 3
lines: [G]Let us [C]labor for [G]the Master
[G]from the [A7]dawn till [D]setting sun,
[G]Let us talk [C]of all His [G]wondrous love and care,
[G]Then, when [D7]all of [G]life is over,
and our work on earth is done,
[D7]And the roll is called up yonder I'll be there.
